_about: Lore data (docs/lore/README.md; decisions 257, 258): entries with facts, each fact saying who knows it. Code uses only status agreed. Facts, never lines to say.

entries.name: the priest
entries.summary: The priest who keeps the town's temple and brings the fallen back.

facts.text: The town's priest brings the fallen back.

entries.name: the medicine man
entries.summary: The medicine man who lives in the healer's hut in the wilds and brings the fallen back.

facts.text: The medicine man in the healer's hut brings the fallen back.

entries.name: the smith
entries.summary: The smith the town must bring home, taken with his hammer.

facts.text: Who took the smith, from where, and where he is held.

entries.name: the smith's hammer
entries.summary: The hammer taken with the smith.

facts.text: Whether the hammer has a name of its own.

entries.name: Wren
entries.summary: Wren is a woman, a companion who rests in town between trips; the rest of who she is comes from her card, which the companions tree rolls and grows.

facts.text: Wren is a woman, a companion who travels with the town's people and rests in town between trips.

entries.name: Pip
entries.summary: Pip is a young man, a companion who rests in town between trips and wants to become a squire; the rest of who he is comes from his card, which the companions tree rolls and grows.

facts.text: Pip is a companion who travels with the town's people and rests in town between trips.
Pip wants to become a squire.
